ns2:course.label: Freshman Honors Course in CS
ns2:course.description: Course is offered for honors credit in conjunction with other 100-level computer science courses, in which concurrent registration is required. Enrollment is strictly limited to beginning students with superior talents in computer science. A special examination may be required for admission to this course. May be repeated. Prerequisite: Concurrent registration in another 100-level computer science course (see Schedule); or consent of instructor.
